questions.question: p->pid means?
options: Field pid of struct at address p

questions.question: Why must UNUSED be 0?
options: Static storage zeroes; 0 = free slot automatically
questions.explanation: Zero-init gives free table without a loop.

questions.question: find_pid returns 0 when?
options: No live row with that pid (miss or reaped)
questions.explanation: NULL = miss; caller must check like malloc.

questions.question: snprintf vs strcpy for name?
options: snprintf caps at size-1+zero; strcpy can smash

questions.question: ZOMBIE->UNUSED models which syscall?
questions.explanation: Parent collects status, frees the row.

questions.question: sizeof may exceed field sums. Why?
questions.explanation: Compiler pads for aligned access; offsets reveal it.
